products: ground beef by the whole or side

feeding_claim.verbatim: Providing Alaskan's with the highest quality local grass-fed beef

pickup_locations: Ace or Alaska Air Cargo facility closest to the buyer

resold_note: Also sells whole and half hogs sourced from a small Idaho producer, not raised on Sitkinak.
notes: Run by Alaska Meat Company (Alaska Grown lists the town as Akhiok); cattle range year round on Sitkinak Island near Kodiak and are harvested with a mobile processing unit. Site says cattle graze native grass all year and are never confined for feeding, but does not use the words grass-finished or say whether grain is ever fed, so category kept at grass-fed. Sells whole and side beef ($500 deposit, priced by hanging weight), quarter beef bundles ($250 deposit) and bulk ground beef; 2026 orders are seasonal (summer and fall processing, fall 2026 delivery), cancellation deadline September 1, 2026. Beef is shipped to Kodiak at no charge; shipping beyond Kodiak (for example Anchorage, about $0.75 per lb) is extra, and buyers pick up at the nearest Ace or Alaska Air Cargo facility. Site names no shipping outside Alaska. Hog page lists Alaska Air Cargo freight to Kodiak, Anchorage, Fairbanks, Cordova, Sitka, Ketchikan and Juneau. No phone or street address on the site; contact by email only.
